projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Here are some of my projects.

projectList.title: Meta-platform
projectList.description: In progress as part of my master's: a lab for building experimental social networks and studying how attention-capturing design patterns affect people. Researchers set up studies with A/B conditions, participants use the network and every event is recorded with the version they saw. The first module (continuous vs. paged comments) works today; the goal is to cover all 15 pattern/alternative pairs from the catalog, with modules that can be swapped without rebuilding the core.

projectList.title: Lumi Invoices
projectList.description: Full-stack monorepo that reads energy bills in PDF with Gemini (multimodal, JSON Mode), stores the structured data in PostgreSQL and shows consumption and costs in a React dashboard with charts and an invoice library.

projectList.title: CBO Classifier
projectList.description: An LLM-assisted entity-matching pipeline that classifies job postings into official six-digit CBO codes, with staged inference, traceability, and structured outputs.

projectList.title: Order Chat
projectList.description: FastAPI WebSocket API for e-commerce support: order status, cancellation with explicit confirmation and exchange policy, with progress events and protocol error handling. Messages can be interpreted by local rules or by Gemini without changing the contract.

projectList.title: Orbit
projectList.description: Windows tray app that controls a Samsung air conditioner and a Tuya lamp over the local network (CoAP/DTLS and Tuya protocol 3.5), without relying on the cloud. Every command is confirmed by the device and keys are protected with Windows DPAPI.

projectList.title: Match Movie
projectList.description: Node.js/NestJS and PostgreSQL backend for a collaborative movie-picking app, with REST APIs, real-time rooms over WebSocket and integrations with TMDb, OpenCage and Ingresso.com.

intro.heading: About me
intro.text: Software Engineer focused on backend systems, systems integration, and operational reliability. I currently work as a Mid-Level Software Developer at Info Sistemas, evolving an ERP with enterprise integrations that supports approximately 50,000 daily requests. My work combines Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, middleware, Redis, Azure, and contract design. At Di Santinni, I delivered Python and Node.js integrations, reduced XML workflow processing time by 60%, and optimized Oracle queries across a database with more than 10 million records.

highlights: Generative AI integrated into the ERP: Designed and built MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools that let a conversational assistant run transactional operations in the system: opening service orders with data extracted from PDFs, bulk-registering assets from spreadsheets, and adjusting contract rates. Business rules live in the MCP layer and the agent API stays generic. Attachments are isolated per conversation, and every write needs explicit confirmation.

Asynchronous processing and reliability: Built a reusable AWS queue with workers for long-running jobs (bulk registration and report exports). It reports progress in real time, produces a final summary, and re-checks data before each write to prevent duplicates under concurrency. Also fixed an out-of-memory (OOM) problem in the NestJS API Gateway.

Financial and tax domain: Built OFX bank statement import with bank reconciliation, and integrations with payment gateways (billing and bank slips, with failure handling for webhooks and status queries). Fixed totals and discount validation when generating invoices (NF-e) from XML. In the procurement module, implemented per-company inventory adjustments and approval workflows.

Engineering and process: Set up an AI-assisted development workflow integrated with Azure DevOps that covers analysis, implementation, independent code review, technical documentation, and build validation. This made delivery more predictable and reduced rework.

Results and metrics: Automated bulk asset registration (up to 50 items per run), cutting the task from about 40 min of manual work to under 3 min. Eliminated the API Gateway OOM, lowering peak memory from ~1.8 GB to ~450 MB and ending service restarts, which had averaged 4 per week. Optimized queries and timeouts in the financial integrations, bringing p95 latency down from ~2,400 ms to ~380 ms. OFX reconciliation processes about 1,500 entries in under 10 s, reducing the finance team's manual effort by ~70%.
Delivered REST APIs in Python (Flask, FastAPI) and Node.js for XML processing and external-system integrations, reducing processing time by 60%.
Optimized Oracle queries over a database with more than 10 million records, improving response time for critical reports by 45%.
Designed XML-to-HTTP transformation middleware and resilient integrations with external APIs.
Developed a desktop WhatsApp application with Node.js, NestJS, Electron, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, serving over 1,200 monthly users.
Designed a microservices architecture with over 80% unit-test coverage, reducing production bugs by 55%.
